models.name: gpt-5.6-sol
models.description: Flagship choice for difficult multi-file engineering, deep reasoning, long-horizon implementation, testing, and demanding review work.

models.name: gpt-5.6-terra
models.description: Balanced choice for everyday development, scoped implementation, first-pass code review, documentation, and general production work.

models.name: gpt-5.6-luna
models.description: Fast choice for well-defined lightweight work such as summaries, code explanations, log analysis, review prechecks, and small routine changes.

models.name: claude-opus
models.description: Use for architectural planning, creative writing, planning-heavy work, and tasks whose requirements are underspecified. Low effort is usually sufficient and is roughly comparable to medium reasoning on GPT-5.6 Sol.

models.name: grok-4.5
models.description: Good at general implementation, use on high resoning for most tasks
